title: Kamran Arora
text:
Kamran Arora






 



Maths PhD student at the University of Bath, supervised by Federico Cornalba and Tony Shardlow. Previously, MMathPhys in Maths and Physics at the University of Warwick.


I study problems at the interface between interacting particle systems and stochastic PDEs using tools from numerical and stochastic analysis.

Research and software







Preprint · 2026


A discontinuous Galerkin approximation of the Dean-Kawasaki equation


We introduce a spatial dG approximation of the Dean-Kawasaki equation. The key ingredient is a general procedure for discretising multiplicative, divergence-form noise on finite element spaces whilst preserving its cross-variation structure.


Kamran Arora, Federico Cornalba and Tony Shardlow

SPDEax


A lightweight JAX + Equinox library of composable spatial discretisations and operators for solving SPDEs with Diffrax. End-to-end differentiable and compatible with jit, grad, vmap.
